title: workstream
description: A grouping of related processes. A detailed workstream has processes; an outline workstream only has a summary.

id.description: Unique id: lower-case letters and numbers joined by hyphens, e.g. presales.

parties.description: The ids of the parties involved.

detail.description: detailed if it has processes, outline if it is only summarised for now.

status.description: How this element differs from today.

today.description: How it works today, shown next to the future state.

examples.name: Presales
examples.summary: From first conversation to signed proposal.
